evidence.P1: P1=3 because several chains rely on and-then or external enablement: Becoming the One ev-005->ev-006 (alarm/Rhineheart reasserts Anderson after rabbit night) and ev-032 (rescue wager invokes Morpheus capture not in that plot), A Love That Requires Belief ev-004->ev-016 (Trinity's singling out does not cause the Jump), and The Matrix Itself ev-020->ev-045 (steak bargain does not cause code-vision without intervening death).
evidence.P2: P2=4 because each plot holds one dilemma stance - Becoming the One on Identity, Believer on Faith vs proof, Love on faith-love, Crew on Freedom vs control, Matrix Itself on Truth vs comfortable lie - without retelling the same story, with only minor framing overlap on shared events like ev-016.
evidence.P3: P3=3 because membership is uneven: Becoming the One omits essential identity birth ev-011 (magenta amnion/coaxial sever) while padding ev-005, A Love That Requires Belief pads ev-016 (Jump) as love evidence, and Crew Against the System omits ev-018 (Agent training program crowds-as-enemy) relevant to surviving Agents.
evidence.P4: P4=4 because all five arcs run setup-turn-resolution: Becoming the One from ev-004 doubt through ev-023 Oracle denial to ev-045/047 awakening/flight, Believer from ev-014 search over through ev-025 sacrifice/ev-031 serum to ev-045 confirmation, and Crew from ev-001 massacre to ev-045 fear, with no dangling thread.
evidence.P5: P5=3 because the same climax events are reused to make the same point across plots: ev-045 (halts volley/enters Smith) appears in all five plots and ev-032 (Neo denies One yet rescues Morpheus) in four plots, and ev-016 appears in three, creating rehash despite different theme labels.

raw.commentary: Hard-marked: causal integrity and membership suffer from weak internal enablement and missing/padded events, perspective and arc remain disciplined, but heavy reuse of ev-045/ev-032 across throughlines creates redundancy.
